query: SELECT * FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE database_name='nfl' ORDER BY schema_name,table_name
rows: League-wide NFL injury report, one row per report entry

rows.vgi.doc_llm: League-wide NFL injury report from ESPN, one row per report entry: team, player, position, status (Questionable, Doubtful, Out, Injured Reserve, Active), body part, estimated return date, and news blurb. Filter by team_abbreviation or status.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current injury report. ESPN's payload is several megabytes, so it is cached in memory for at least a minute.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Players ruled out or on injured reserve for Kansas City.", "sql": "SELECT athlete_name, position, status, injury_type, return_date FROM nfl.main.current_injuries WHERE team_abbreviation = 'KC' AND status IN ('Out', 'Injured Reserve') ORDER BY status, athlete_name"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NFL Injury Report

rows: CREATE TABLE current_injuries(injury_id VARCHAR, team_id INTEGER, team_abbreviation VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, athlete_id INTEGER, athlete_name VARCHAR, "position" VARCHAR, status VARCHAR, status_abbreviation VARCHAR, injury_type VARCHAR, injury_location VARCHAR, injury_detail VARCHAR, injury_side VARCHAR, return_date DATE, short_comment VARCHAR, long_comment VARCHAR, reported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, PRIMARY KEY(injury_id));
This week's NFL games with live or final scores, one row per game

rows.vgi.doc_llm: This week's NFL games from ESPN, one row per game: kickoff, status (pre/in/post), live or final scores, records, winner, venue, and broadcast. Start here for 'what is the score' or 'who plays this week'. For another week call scoreboard(season, week).
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current NFL week's scoreboard as an ordinary table. Scores are NULL before kickoff. Use `game_id` with `game_summary()`, `box_score_player()`, and related functions.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "This week's games with live or final scores.", "sql": "SELECT short_name, status_detail, away_score, home_score FROM nfl.main.current_scoreboard ORDER BY game_time"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NFL Scoreboard

rows: CREATE TABLE current_scoreboard(game_id VARCHAR, season INTEGER, season_type INTEGER, "week" INTEGER, game_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, "name" VARCHAR, short_name VARCHAR, status VARCHAR, status_state VARCHAR, status_detail VARCHAR, completed BOOLEAN, period INTEGER, clock VARCHAR, home_team_id INTEGER, home_team_abbreviation VARCHAR, home_team_name VARCHAR, home_score INTEGER, home_record VARCHAR, away_team_id INTEGER, away_team_abbreviation VARCHAR, away_team_name VARCHAR, away_score INTEGER, away_record VARCHAR, winner_abbreviation VARCHAR, venue VARCHAR, venue_city VARCHAR, venue_state VARCHAR, neutral_site BOOLEAN, attendance INTEGER, broadcast VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(game_id));
Current NFL regular-season standings, one row per team

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current NFL regular-season standings from ESPN, one row per team: conference, division, division_rank, playoff_seed (1-7 qualify), W-L-T, win percentage, games back, points for/against, streak, home/road/division/conference records, and clinch marker. For past seasons call standings(season := ...).
rows.vgi.doc_md: Current division standings as an ordinary read-only table.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Division tables in rank order.", "sql": "SELECT division, division_rank, team_name, wins, losses, ties, games_back FROM nfl.main.current_standings ORDER BY division, division_rank"}, {"description": "Current playoff field by conference seed.", "sql": "SELECT conference, playoff_seed, team_name, wins, losses FROM nfl.main.current_standings WHERE playoff_seed <= 7 ORDER BY conference, playoff_seed"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NFL Standings

rows: CREATE TABLE current_standings(season INTEGER, season_type INTEGER, conference VARCHAR, conference_name VARCHAR, division VARCHAR, division_rank INTEGER, playoff_seed INTEGER, team_id INTEGER, team_abbreviation VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, wins INTEGER, losses INTEGER, "ties" INTEGER, win_percentage DECIMAL(4,3), games_back DECIMAL(4,1), points_for INTEGER, points_against INTEGER, point_differential INTEGER, streak VARCHAR, streak_length INTEGER, home_record VARCHAR, road_record VARCHAR, division_record VARCHAR, conference_record VARCHAR, clincher VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(team_id));
The current NFL season, phase, and week

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row with the current NFL season, phase (pre/regular/post/off), week, and display week from Sleeper. Use it to parameterize scoreboard() or nflverse functions for 'this week'.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Sleeper's NFL state. `week` advances early in the week; `display_week` lags.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "The current season and week.", "sql": "SELECT season, phase, week, display_week FROM nfl.main.current_week"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NFL Week

rows: CREATE TABLE current_week(season INTEGER, phase VARCHAR, "week" INTEGER, display_week INTEGER, previous_season INTEGER, season_start_date DATE, PRIMARY KEY(season));
Every NFL player in nflverse's directory with cross-source ids

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Every NFL player in nflverse's directory (about 25,000, historical and current): GSIS id, name, position, birth date, size, college, draft, latest team, status, and cross-ids for ESPN, PFR, PFF, NFL.com, and OverTheCap. Use it to find an espn_id for player_game_log() or to join nflverse stats by gsis_id.
rows.vgi.doc_md: nflverse player directory with identifier crosswalk (CC-BY 4.0).
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Look up Patrick Mahomes's identifiers.", "sql": "SELECT gsis_id, espn_id, pfr_id, position, latest_team FROM nfl.main.players WHERE display_name = 'Patrick Mahomes'"}]
rows.vgi.title: NFL Players

rows: CREATE TABLE players(gsis_id VARCHAR, display_name VARCHAR, first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR, "position" VARCHAR, position_group VARCHAR, birth_date DATE, height_inches INTEGER, weight_lbs INTEGER, college VARCHAR, jersey_number VARCHAR, rookie_season INTEGER, last_season INTEGER, latest_team VARCHAR, status VARCHAR, years_of_experience INTEGER, draft_year INTEGER, draft_round INTEGER, draft_pick INTEGER, draft_team VARCHAR, espn_id INTEGER, pfr_id VARCHAR, pff_id VARCHAR, nfl_id VARCHAR, esb_id VARCHAR, otc_id VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(gsis_id));
The 32 NFL franchises with ESPN ids and abbreviations

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The 32 NFL franchises from ESPN: ESPN team_id, abbreviation, full name, location, nickname, and colors. Use abbreviations with roster(), depth_chart(), and team_schedule(). nflverse uses LA and WAS where ESPN uses LAR and WSH.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Every franchise and its ESPN abbreviation.", "sql": "SELECT team_abbreviation, team_name FROM nfl.main.teams ORDER BY team_name"}]
rows.vgi.title: NFL Teams

rows: CREATE TABLE teams(team_id INTEGER, team_abbreviation VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, short_name VARCHAR, "location" VARCHAR, nickname VARCHAR, slug VARCHAR, color VARCHAR, alternate_color VARCHAR, is_active BOOLEAN, PRIMARY KEY(team_id));
